source.name: postmortems.app
source.note: Entries are pinned by Git blob SHA. EvalForge does not treat the repository's enriched summaries as primary-source ground truth; original incident sources must be snapshotted/verified before research admission.

candidates.title: AWS US-East Region Service Event of October 22, 2012
candidates.evidence_summary: The incident narrative explicitly identifies an EBS data-collection-agent memory leak that slowly consumed system memory and degraded request handling.
candidates.decision_reason: Direct match to EvalForge's runtime resource-exhaustion memory_leak label.

candidates.title: Tarsnap outage 2016-07-24
candidates.evidence_summary: A background-job log grew without bound until it filled the filesystem, causing critical writes to fail and the service to stop.
candidates.decision_reason: Direct match to disk_exhaustion rather than a generic disk hardware/storage failure.

candidates.title: GKE Dataplane V2 anetd CPU saturation causes connection timeouts
candidates.evidence_summary: The narrative reports an accidental N+1 database join, but identifies GKE Dataplane V2 anetd CPU saturation and packet drops as the persistent incident root cause.
candidates.decision_reason: N+1 behavior was a separate contributing issue, so labeling the whole incident n_plus_one_query would overstate the evidence.

candidates.title: Twilio billing system incident of July 2013
candidates.evidence_summary: A network partition overloaded Redis; a restart then loaded an incorrect configuration/read-only state, after which auto-recharge repeatedly charged customers.
candidates.decision_reason: The incident is billing-related and configuration contributed materially, but the causal chain is broader than the frozen broken_payment_configuration label.

candidates.title: Elastic Cloud AWS us-east-1 outage of February 2019
candidates.evidence_summary: The report mentions Kibana connection leaks during remediation, while the primary outage root cause is ZooKeeper coordination-layer instability and loss of quorum.
candidates.decision_reason: The cited leaks are not established database-connection leaks and are not the primary incident root cause.

candidates.title: Cloudflare parser bug causes memory leak
candidates.evidence_summary: The root cause is a parser buffer over-read/pointer-boundary bug that disclosed memory contents, not progressive runtime memory consumption.
candidates.decision_reason: Keyword/title says memory leak, but it does not match EvalForge's resource-exhaustion memory_leak semantics.

candidates.title: Skyliner outages on 2017-01-19 and 2017-01-23
candidates.evidence_summary: The pinned entry states only that a third-party-library memory leak caused two outages, without enough incident detail for family/evidence construction.
candidates.decision_reason: Potential label match, but evidence is too thin to admit as a locked research incident without preserving the original source narrative.
